title: TEI-XML transcriptions of 318 early modern play editions (Hugh Craig set, APEX / De Montfort University)
license_note: Zenodo record 14289452 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14289452) is open access with licence CC BY 4.0 (cc-by-4.0 in the record metadata).
institution: APEX, De Montfort University (Gabriel Egan); texts supplied by Hugh Craig
notes:
Zenodo dataset (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14289452) containing TEI-XML transcriptions of 318 editions of 288 early modern plays by 77 authors (count stated in the dataset description). Base texts are double-keyed EEBO-TCP-style transcriptions supplied by Hugh Craig, with minor corrections by Gabriel Egan; related corrected subsets (e.g. Folio-only Shakespeare plays) are deposited separately on Zenodo. Word count not published.

Justification: A project-released, corrected TEI full-text dataset of Renaissance-era printed drama, freely downloadable with a stable DOI, not in the catalogue. Found via a Zenodo search for TEI-encoded early modern play corpora.
Found at: https://zenodo.org/records/14289452
